text:
lina (support): FYI customer on Private VPC is seeing streaming websocket connections drop after ~60-70s. App receives close with code 1006. No obvious app error. Repro steps below.

rachel (customer): Confirmed. Using our product chat -> server sends continuous partial tokens but stream is cut. Happens consistently in our corp network, not from home.

lina (support): Thanks. Can you paste a minimal repro and network capture? Also which deployment (VPC / Dedicated)?

rachel (customer): Private deployment in our VPC, egress via NAT -> corporate proxy. Repro: `wscat -c "wss://private-api.redwood.example/v1/streams" -H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` then send prompt. Stream starts, then stops at ~65s. Error: `connection closed abnormally (1006)`. Attaching tcpdump snippet: `... TCP FIN from proxy at t+65s`.

sam (eng-sre): Sounds like a middlebox idle timeout or buffering proxy. Two common culprits: 1) TCP/HTTP idle timeouts (ALB / corporate proxy) that kill idle connections, 2) HTTP proxy that buffers responses until content-length satisfied (so streaming payloads get buffered and only flushed when connection closes).

alex (eng-runtime): Agreed. Also we see similar reports when ALB idle timeout is 60s by default. If traffic goes through an ALB or corporate load balancer, it can close the socket. Another pattern is proxies that don't support `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` well and hold until buffer full.

mike (solutions): Quick checks: 1) Does server send any keepalive/ping frames (websocket ping/pong) or periodic whitespace? 2) Is there an HTTP proxy (explicit) vs NAT gateway? 3) Any TLS termination in the path?

rachel (customer): We do TLS at the edge (managed), then traffic hits corporate proxy for outbound egress. We don't see pings from server. Can we enable something quick?

sam (eng-sre): Two mitigation options immediately: 1) Send websocket-level pings every 20-30s from client or server. 2) Send small chunked heartbeats (newline or single space) periodically to avoid idle timeout and prevent buffering if proxy flushes per-chunk. Example server quick hack: 

```js
// send heartbeat every 25s
setInterval(() => websocket.send('\n'), 25000);
```

Note: some proxies will buffer even chunked responses. For nginx/proxy buffer config see below.

alex (eng-runtime): If the path includes nginx as reverse proxy, ensure config contains: 

```nginx
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
proxy_set_header Connection "Upgrade";
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```

If ALB is in front, increase idle timeout: `aws elbv2 modify-load-balancer-attributes --load-balancer-arn <arn> --attributes Key=idle_timeout.timeout_seconds,Value=120`

sam (eng-sre): For corporate proxies (BlueCoat, F5, etc.) they often terminate and re-initiate TLS and impose 60s idle. Customer needs to validate with network team and request a longer idle or allow websocket passthrough.

rachel (customer): I asked our network team. They said the corporate proxy will enforce 60s idle and can't change policy. Any other options?

mike (solutions): If proxy policy can't change, we should implement robust keepalives at application layer. Two approaches: 1) websocket ping/pong or periodic data frames (whitespace) from server; 2) shorter client reconnect logic with resume support (if server supports streaming resumability). We'll document reconnection strategy.

alex (eng-runtime): We should also add guidance + SDK defaults: enable websocket-level pings every 20s from client and server, and make streaming chunk sizes small with frequent flushes. I'll file a runtime docs ticket to add config and examples.

sam (eng-sre): For debugging please gather: 1) tcpdump showing FIN/RESET timing, 2) server access logs showing last write, 3) client console logs (wscat/websocat), 4) any proxy logs. Use this command to repro + tcpdump on client side: `sudo tcpdump -s0 -w /tmp/ws.pcap host <proxy_ip> and port 443` then run wscat.

rachel (customer): Adding logs to ticket INC-2026-314. I attached pcap and server logs. pcap shows pause then FIN from proxy at t+63.

lina (support): Escalating to eng-runtime and eng-sre for upstream action (docs + possible server heartbeat changes). Eng-sre: can you confirm if we can change any default timeouts in Private control plane / egress NAT?

sam (eng-sre): In private deployments we don't control customer's corporate proxy. For our side: ensure we keep websocket connections alive at our edge, tune idle timeouts if we are behind ALB, and provide explicit docs for customers about middlebox patterns. Also check if our managed TLS termination is rewriting headers that cause proxy buffering.

alex (eng-runtime): Action items: 
- A-1: Add SDK example for automatic websocket pings and small chunked heartbeats.
- A-2: Add troubleshooting doc: "Streaming stalls and middleboxes" (include nginx, ALB, corporate proxies, keepalive configs).
- A-3: Investigate adding `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` + flush hints for our streaming endpoints.

mike (solutions): I'll draft a short KB to send to rachel's network team showing minimal changes (heartbeat example + tcpdump repro).

rachel (customer): Thanks. Implemented server heartbeat hack and confirmed streams now stay alive beyond 2 minutes when tested from corp net. Will keep monitoring.

lina (support): Marking as resolved for now pending follow-up docs. Reopen INC-2026-314 if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
